title: The Stolen Signet
introduction: You arrive at a ruined watchtower to recover a stolen family signet.
objective: Retrieve the stolen signet and leave through the reliquary's far exit.

locations.name: Entrance
locations.description: You stand at the entrance to a ruined watchtower. Rain beads on the old stone.

locations.name: Guardroom
locations.description: Dust blankets an abandoned guardroom where open passages lead onward and back.

locations.name: Reliquary
locations.description: A vaulted reliquary waits in silence beyond the guardroom passage.

features.name: ruined archway
features.description: The cracked archway still bears the worn crest of the old watch.

features.name: cold hearth
features.description: Only grey ash remains in the hearth; no fire has burned here for years.

features.name: stone pedestal
features.description: The stone pedestal is carved with curling ivy and heraldic shields.

doors.name: wooden door
doors.description: A sturdy wooden door bound with weathered iron straps.

equipment.name: longsword
equipment.description: A dependable steel longsword, kept ready at your side.

monsterDefinitions.name: goblin
monsterDefinitions.description: A wiry goblin in battered leather grips a nicked scimitar.

items.name: signet
items.description: A silver signet engraved with the fighter's family crest, stolen but unharmed.
